notes.title: Update 2.2.0: UI Elements to guide users
notes.content: Added UI element to guide users on how to connect to twitch and set up everything

notes.title: Update 2.1.0: Added option to accept answer that start with ! only
notes.content: Added option to accept answer that start with ! only rather than accepting any message in chat

notes.title: Update 2.0.0: New UI
notes.content: Significant improvement to the question result UI and End result UI

notes.title: Update 1.3.0: Bonus Points to First 3 Correct Answers
notes.content:
Now before starting the question set, you can assign bonus points to the first 3 viewers to answer correctly.

This will give viewers incentive to answer as fast as they can rather than waiting for others and stealing the answers :D

notes.title: Update 1.2.4: Lock Viewer Correct Answer
notes.content:
Added option to lock the viewer's answer if it correct.
This will allow the viewer to chat without worry of changing the answer

notes.title: Update 1.2.3: Fixed bug where chat 4 cannot submit answers
notes.content: Fixed bug where chat 4 cannot submit answers

notes.title: Update 1.2.0: Chatters can join mid game
notes.content:
Viewers/Chatters can join mid game now by typing !play or play. This only applies if you enable the live entry option in the "Connect to Twitch" interface.

Minor update: Chat answers are now highlighted green or red to indicate if the answer is correct or not

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Premade Question sets on Dropbox
notes.content:
The download question set button will now lead you to a Dropbox page rather than a google drive page.
Dropbox allows for more download requests than google drive.
